# Is your RDS or Aurora instance too big?

> Paste CloudWatch CPU, freeable memory and connection numbers (or describe-db-instances JSON) and see which RDS and Aurora instances are over- or under-provisioned, the next class in the same family, Graviton savings, Multi-AZ cost and the modify-db-instance command. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to right-size an RDS instance](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/rds-instance-rightsizer/how-to-right-size-an-rds-instance.html)
